expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds the block + hash milestone with TODOs; no full chain with PoW, transactions, P2P
expectations.evidence: Delivered only the first milestone per prompt '带我开始第一步': Block class with compute_hash(), genesis block, add_block (~40 lines, blockchain.py). No PoW, transactions, or P2P implemented anywhere; PoW only named as future step: '下一步自然是给区块加**工作量证明（PoW）**'. Not a multi-milestone dump.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with a runnable checkpoint and expected behaviour: '运行后复制某个块的哈希，然后改它的 `data` 再跑一次——你会发现它的哈希变了，而且后面所有块的 `previous_hash` 都对不上'; command concretely demonstrated as 'python3 blockchain.py' and confirmed 'blockchain.py 已能运行'.

expectations.text: B3: Block hash covers index/timestamp/data/previous hash via SHA-256
expectations.evidence: compute_hash covers all four fields via SHA-256: 'content = f"{self.index}{self.timestamp}{self.data}{self.previous_hash}"' then 'hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only command run was 'python3 blockchain.py' (SHELL COMMANDS RUN (1)); only file written is blockchain.py inside the project dir; no brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install/gem install anywhere; only stdlib hashlib/time used.
